title: Russian diplomat summoned yet again by Latvia over ongoing aggression
summary_full: On 23rd November 2026, the Chargé d’Affaires ad interim of the Russian Embassy in Rīga was summoned to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to lodge a protest with the Russian Federation over the consequences of its war of aggression against Ukraine, as well as violations of the airspace of Member States of the European Union and NATO, according to a release from the Ministry.
